bio:

how i think
I see every problem as a system—break it down, optimize it, and ensure everything is connected and resilient. Whether it’s structuring data workflows, enhancing customer retention with analytics, or fine-tuning chatbots & NLP models, I bring a systematic, data-driven approach to every challenge.
what drives me
I believe in continuous learning, whether it’s mastering Google Looker Studio for business visuals, understanding telecom SSIS projects, or exploring machine learning for smarter decision-making. I also enjoy teaching & mentoring, helping others make sense of data just as I do.
you’ll find me teaching coding & data to kids, experimenting with chatbot development, or enhancing my English & communication skills. I enjoy breaking down complex concepts into simple, engaging insights—because data should tell a story, not just be numbers.
